name: Public Registry
checked_how: Read-only GET of each URL. Edit this file by hand when a status changes; the site build makes no network calls.

on_chain.summary: The registry publishes day roots and proofs, but its anchors are still pending: the anchoring treasury holds 0 sats, so no root has been written to a public blockchain yet.

signing_keys.summary: The registry's permanent signing keys are not in place yet, so it issues no signed Modular City records.

checks.title: Check a file
checks.what: Choose a file and the page hashes it in your browser, then looks the fingerprint up in the registry's anchored files. Only the fingerprint is sent.

checks.title: Look up a record by its fingerprint
checks.what: Enter an anchored record's fingerprint to see the record, its anchor status and any corrections.

checks.title: Licensed-merchant certificates
checks.status_label: Live, no Modular City certificates yet
checks.what: What a BRC-52 licensed-merchant certificate says, and how to check one. Modular City certificates wait for the registry's permanent signing keys.

checks.title: Event stream
checks.what: Every registry action in order, with no gaps, as JSON.

checks.title: Anchoring fee treasury
checks.what: Deposits and the fee spent on each anchor, as JSON. Until it is funded, no anchor is written to a public blockchain.

checks.title: A day's fingerprint
checks.status_label: Live, roots not yet on chain
checks.what: One Merkle root over every record the registry anchored that UTC day, with its leaves in order. Swap in any past date. Today's day answers that it is still open.

checks.title: One record's place in its day
checks.status_label: Live, roots not yet on chain
checks.what: The inclusion proof linking one anchor to its day's root, in the same shape as the example on this page. Swap in any anchor number.
